Fig05_final_test_confusion_matrices: Matrices pool all valid pixels from 24 internal-test tile-date views. Rows are final reporting-reference labels; columns are predictions using the original validation-fixed threshold for each selected model. Cell text gives absolute counts and row percentages; a common 0-1 row-normalized color scale prevents background prevalence from masking root recall. Retained original baselines exactly reproduce the old package; new eligible checkpoints have freshly computed counts on the unchanged reference. The reference is not an independently collected external test.
Fig06_final_test_ROC_AUC_and_PR: ROC/AUC and precision-recall/AP are computed from the selected models saved continuous float32 test probabilities, not binary masks. All valid pixels of the same 24 final-reference tile-date views are included with no sampling or difficult-region exclusion. Tied probability scores are grouped; AUC uses the full empirical ROC with trapezoidal integration and AP uses non-interpolated step integration. Plot traces retain up to 5000 display points, while AUC/AP include every unique threshold. PR is included because root/background pixels are imbalanced. Dates/tiles are correlated; no pixel-independence confidence intervals or external generalization claims are made.
